holdout_role: model selection, prompt/reward tuning, and checkpoint selection only

visibility_note: the published manifests are procedurally held out, not cryptographically hidden

timeout_result: retain and report as an explicit failure
aggregation: aggregate instance metrics within task, then macro-average across tasks
